output: Hypothesis: There is no significant association between the rate of Body Elongation evolution ('BEL_evol') and the rate of Relative Maxillary Length evolution ('RML_evol'), as well as between the rate of Body Elongation evolution ('BEL_evol') and soil diversity ('soil_div'). This is supported by the correlation coefficients of 0.0432 (p = 0.3552) and -0.0384 (p = 0.4109), respectively, which are not statistically significant at the 0.05 level.
